'''Green Team''' was a unit of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives working in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]. They were involved in the [[Battle for Black Ice|capture]] of the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''. They inflicted heavy damage on the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].
